132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

2040-complete.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-complete.text: Well done, $N. Thanks to you, Gnomeregan is one step closer to its day of liberation!
2040-complete.title: Underground Assault

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

214-complete.name: Scout Riell
214-complete.text: Well done, $N!  On behalf of The People's Militia I salute you for your efforts.  Soon we will return this land to the people with help from brave souls like you.
214-complete.title: Red Silk Bandanas

214-progress.name: Scout Riell
214-progress.text: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang?  If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.
214-progress.title: Red Silk Bandanas

256-accept.name: Unknown
256-accept.text:
By order of the Magistrate of Thelsamar:

Chok'sul, the ogre presumed to be the leader and coordinator of attacks against the town of Thelsamar, Stonewrought Dam, and the excavation site, is wanted dead through any means necessary.

Monetary compensation will be provided when proof is brought to the Magistrate of Chok'sul's death.

Chok'sul was last seen at the ogre encampment in the northeastern part of Loch Modan.
256-accept.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

273-accept.name: Jern Hornhelm
273-accept.text:
It's not too late though, you're welcome to go look for Huldar. He can't have made it very far, strong as they are, Miran and Saean can only move so fast laden down with those barrels.

They're taking the normal route to the site, leaving south out of town and following the curve of the Loch.

Shouldn't have a problem finding them unless they've already gotten there.
273-accept.title: Resupplying the Excavation

302-complete.name: Jern Hornhelm
302-complete.text:
What? Stormpike wants you to personally see the shipment to Ironband?

I... suppose that's fine, the only problem is, I've already sent Huldar with the porters, Miran and Saean. You just missed them, they left just a short while ago.
302-complete.title: Powder to Ironband

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

373-complete.name: Baros Alexston
373-complete.text:
Edwin VanCleef, you say? I would as much expect a letter from my dead grandmother... So you've killed him then? Pardon me in saying, but I'm somewhat surprised. He was a peerless fighter in his younger years. Let's see what he finds the need to write to me about after so many years.

<Baros peruses the letter.>

Edwin... I see the years haven't changed you a bit, an idealist as ever, and a romantic. He doesn't care who he hurts, $N. Revenge has consumed him. But then, I'm not sure I can blame him.
373-complete.title: The Unsent Letter

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

389-accept.name: Baros Alexston
389-accept.text:
VanCleef and I were members of the Stonemasons Guild. Our main project was to rebuild Stormwind after the War.

When we had finished our duties, we were cheated. The nobles refused to pay us for our work. Some of the more senior of the Stonemasons were offered governmental jobs, but VanCleef refused it out of loyalty to all the Stonemasons. He led a riot and left the city, swearing revenge.

His lieutenant, Bazil Thredd, might know more about VanCleef's plans. He's being held prisoner in the Stockade.
389-accept.title: Bazil Thredd

389-complete.name: Warden Thelwater
389-complete.text:
What in the Light do you want? Can't you see we have a crisis here?

Bazil Thredd?! Why would you want to speak with that bastard? How am I supposed to know you're not one of his cronies, come down to help with his bloody riot? If all the blasted cells weren't open, I might throw you in one for a while!
389-complete.title: Bazil Thredd

391-accept.name: Warden Thelwater
391-accept.text:
Let's get one thing straight, $N: I don't trust you. But, with the situation as it is, you probably won't make a difference.

So here's how it's going to be: go down there and have your talk with Thredd. If you're really on our side, then kill him and bring me his head when the job's done. And if it turns out you're on his side, and don't come out... when we find you, you'll die along with the rest of the maggots.
391-accept.title: The Stockade Riots

399-complete.name: Baros Alexston
399-complete.text: Oh, thank you, $N! It's of no practical use to me, but the sentimental value... Needless to say, thank you for bringing this to me... at some cost to your own well-being, not to mention the time it took to go all the way down to Westfall. You have my gratitude, and have this as a token of my thanks.
399-complete.title: Humble Beginnings
